mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.title AS title, d.type AS type, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.like_count AS likeCount, kb.name AS kbName FROM document d LEFT JOIN knowledge_base kb ON d.kb_id = kb.id WHERE d.is_public = 1 ORDER BY d.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT kb.id AS id, kb.name AS name, COUNT(d.id) AS docCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.view_count), 0) AS totalViews, u.name AS creatorName FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN user u ON kb.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN document d ON kb.id = d.kb_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE kb.is_public = 1 AND kb.deleted = 0 GROUP BY kb.id, kb.name, u.name ORDER BY totalViews DESC LIMIT #{limit}
